shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,160p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg \"new Ajv|interface Options|type Options\" node_modules/ajv -g '*.d.ts' | head -40 && rg \"export interface ToolDefinition|inputSchema\" src/types/ai.ts && rg \"reanchor|spec-links\" scripts package.json && git log -3 --oneline --stat"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,60p' node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts && cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | sed -n '1,50p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- CHANGELOG.md package.json .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,180p' scripts/check-changelog.sh && sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md && git diff origin/main...HEAD -- CHANGELOG.md package.json | sed -n '1,240p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,90p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md | sed -n '1,320p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "feat(tools): validate resolved input schemas" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch'
